title: The Unexplained Hessdalen Lights

scenes.text: Bright orange orbs appear over a Norwegian valley for minutes
Phenomena occur in the remote Hessdalen Valley of central Norway
The lights have been recorded on video since 1981

scenes.archive_query: Hessdalen lights 1995 research footage Wikimedia Commons
scenes.text: Official Norwegian research team filmed a bright pulse in 1995

scenes.label: UNSOLVED CAUSE
scenes.sub: Atmospheric plasma, piezoelectric rocks, or unknown

scenes.text: Follow for a new mystery every day.

description: Since the 1980s, glowing orbs have haunted the Hessdalen Valley, drawing scientists and skeptics alike. Their origin remains a heated debate.
